B A S I S O F P R E PA R AT I O N
Prepared from SaveHatke coupon marketplace, settlement and payout records for the period 1 August 2026 to 31 August 2026, generated on 1 September 2026.
Amounts are in Indian Rupees and rounded to the nearest rupee; percentages are rounded to two decimals and may not sum exactly to stated totals. Sellers are
paid 100% of the listed coupon code price with no commission deducted; platform revenue arises solely from the buyer-side service fee applied at checkout, so
seller revenue, platform service fee revenue and admin revenue are mutually exclusive and no amount is counted twice. Revenue distribution follows the configured
40% / 40% / 20% split between Admin 1, Admin 2 and the SaveHatke platform. This report contains financial and marketplace performance information only; it
deliberately excludes customer and seller personal information, account identifiers, contact details, login and session data, security and incident information,
support cases, chatbot records, audit logs, device and network details.
